summary: The world's most populous nation and largest democracy, a nuclear power and fast-rising economy. A leader of the Global South pursuing 'strategic autonomy' — balancing between the US, Russia and China rather than joining any bloc.

history.detail: Crown rule replaces the East India Company after the 1857 rebellion.
Britain leaves; India and Pakistan split amid mass violence and displacement of ~15 million.
Independence leader killed by a Hindu nationalist.
China defeats India in a Himalayan border war; distrust endures.
India intervenes; East Pakistan becomes independent Bangladesh.
'Smiling Buddha' — India joins the nuclear club.
Balance-of-payments crisis triggers market reforms and rapid growth.
Pokhran-II tests; India declares itself a nuclear-weapons state.
Narendra Modi's BJP wins power; Hindu-nationalist, pro-business agenda.
Deadly hand-to-hand fighting with China; first combat deaths on the border in decades.
India overtakes China in population; hosts the G20 summit.

finance.currency_role: Indian rupee; capital controls; pushing rupee trade settlement

resources.oil_gas: Major importer; buys discounted Russian oil since 2022
resources.rare_earths: Sizeable reserves; developing processing to reduce China reliance
resources.water: Monsoon-dependent; water stress a growing risk
resources.agriculture: Largest producer of milk, pulses and spices; huge farm workforce

follow_the_money.detail: India became a top buyer of sanctioned Russian crude, reselling refined products globally.
World's largest recipient (~$120bn/yr) from its global diaspora.
Homegrown instant-payment rails now being exported to other countries.

theories_disputed.detail: Canada and the US accused Indian agents of targeting Sikh separatists on their soil; India denies but a US case led to charges.
Reports alleged the government used Israeli Pegasus spyware against journalists and opposition; official inquiry inconclusive.

connections.detail: Quad partner; defence and tech ties deepening
Legacy arms supplier; oil trade despite Western pressure
Four wars; Kashmir dispute; nuclear rivals
